page.title: Automations
page.description: Start the agent at a time, when a command’s output changes, or when a URL is called.
page.emptyHint: Ask the agent in any conversation, or click New Automation.

editor.name: Name
editor.pausedHint: Paused. It runs only with Run Now until you turn it on.
editor.deleteBody: Its runs’ conversations stay, and join the sidebar.

pausedBecause.conversation_archived: Paused because its conversation was archived.
pausedBecause.conversation_deleted: Paused because its conversation was deleted.

trigger.title: Trigger
trigger.momentInvalid: Enter a date and time as 2026-10-18 08:00.
trigger.intervalInvalid: Enter a whole number, 1 or more.
trigger.expressionHint: Minute, hour, day of month, month and weekday: {words}.
trigger.commandHint: Runs in the target’s directory. A run starts when its output or exit status changes; the first check only records it.
trigger.cloudCost: Each check runs on the Cloud and wakes it, so checking often keeps the Cloud running.
trigger.regenerateBody: Calls with the current secret will be refused from then on.
trigger.stripeHint: Stripe makes its own secret: paste it here to accept the events Stripe signs.
trigger.limitHint: Once reached, later changes and calls start nothing until midnight.
trigger.limitInvalid: Enter a whole number, 1 or more, or leave it empty.
trigger.addressHint: Another system calls it with a POST to start a run.
trigger.secretHint: Send it as Authorization: Bearer <secret>, or paste it in a GitHub webhook’s Secret field.

target.title: Target
target.newHint: Each run starts an empty conversation, which knows only what the prompt says.
target.existingHint: Each run wakes it with a message, and it goes on with everything it holds.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.hint: What each run sends, written as you’d write it to the agent.
prompt.placeholder: Check yesterday’s failed payments, and notify me if there are any.

model.label: Model
model.hint: A new conversation starts with it; an existing one keeps its own.
model.missing: Runs need a model to start a new conversation.

note.limit: The limit of {limit} runs a day was reached, {calls} call since | The limit of {limit} runs a day was reached, {calls} calls since
note.targetGone: Its conversation was archived or deleted

notify.off: Runs tell you what they find with notifications, which are off in all your browsers.
